headline: S&P raised Uzbekistan's credit rating to BB+. One notch left to investment grade
summary: S&P Global Ratings upgraded Uzbekistan's sovereign rating from BB to BB+ with a stable outlook, its highest ever. The next step would be investment grade, BBB-.
why: Sovereign credit ratings shape borrowing costs for governments and influence foreign investor appetite for a country's debt and assets.
